selection: Frozen CSV k, never chosen using truth. Plot exclusion does not exclude homogeneous starts from the article.
velocity_metric: Equal-volume RMSE against original 100-m piecewise-constant truth throughout 20x8x8 km; repeat 800-m inversion cells, not coarse block-slowness truth.
hypocenter_metric: Linear P90 of 3D Euclidean MAP errors over all 3465 events, using iter_k training-only E-step weights in V_k; first argmax on ties; coordinates=(positions+0.5)*100 m.
timing: iter_k/model.npy is V_k after k updates, verified against quality[k-1]. Control stopping is separate from the L-curve selection; stopping update retained.
event_alignment: event_i follows source events.csv row i, not sorted ID. Runtime loader row-order protocol and input hashes preserved; legacy meta does not independently store event IDs.
weights_hash_protocol: SHA256 of concatenated UTF-8 lines: row_index TAB event_id TAB SHA256(weights.npz) NEWLINE, in source catalogue order.
caveats: Synthetic geology with real catalogue/station geometry, not observed velocities or independently verified event truth.
No real missing-pick mask: complete 3465x26 synthetic picks before seeded 10% pick holdout. All events retain training picks; P90 is not a held-out-event score.
3244 events have at least one held-out pick. Their subset P90 is audit only, not the article all-event P90.
Supplied 1D start is truth-derived: arithmetic horizontal mean Vp, Gaussian depth smoothing sigma=0.4 km (reflect), then 800-m depth-bin averaging.
Cap7 pairs reuse the same arrivals/noise realization and split; they are budget/runtime audits, not independent noise replicates.
Cap20 1D stops at 9 updates by control plateau; homogeneous reaches 20-update cap. No rollback to a truth-selected model.
Station elevation/catalogue depth datum compatibility is an unverified source assumption.
No inversions, forward modelling or FMM executed; extraction capped at 300 seconds.

model_source.velocity_values: Preserved exactly; float32 source values stored losslessly as float64 by VelocityGrid

description.interpretation: Illustrative synthetic upper crust, not an observed or calibrated site model
description.section_sampling: Analytic field at exact central planes, 100-m in-plane pixel centres
description.scaling_note: Fixed-centre spatial dilation; basin/fault/fabric anchored at surface; features clipped by unchanged domain

features.basin: Undulating sediment/basement contact; deepest near (7, 4.4) km; additional thickness factor 1
features.fault: Oblique curved corridor dipping about 65 degrees; additional thickness factor 1; up to -0.72 km/s
features.alteration: Tilted low-Vp lens centred at (10.216, 4.8, 3.8) km; -0.54 km/s peak
features.intrusion: Tilted mafic body centred at (15.0, 3.8, 4.8) km; unchanged size and +0.72 km/s peak
features.fabric: 18 deterministic sinusoidal modes; wavelengths doubled; nominal RMS 0.0525 km/s

original_real_geometry.datum_caveat: Station elevations and catalog depths are assumed to share a sea-level vertical datum; compatibility has not been independently established.

source_geometry.embedding: Keep real metric coordinates and origin unchanged; extend upper domain bounds only
source_geometry.event_selection: Exactly the 3471 event IDs in the approved real-inversion training archive, in its order
source_geometry.source_position_policy: Catalog coordinates are synthetic source truth only, not real-data ground truth
source_geometry.station_policy: All 31 real-inversion stations, unchanged xyz including elevation-derived z; not flattened
source_geometry.observations_policy: Fresh synthetic arrivals for every event/station pair; no real observed times or real missing-pick mask
source_geometry.datum_caveat: Station elevations and catalog depths are assumed to share a sea-level vertical datum; compatibility has not been independently established.

crop_source_bounds_m.boundary_policy: closed; keep points exactly on a crop face

geometry.truth_crop: source_velocity[1:,:2,:2]; preserve checkerboard phase, do not regenerate
geometry.forward_status: Inputs prepared for a fresh cropped-domain solve; no original-domain arrivals reused

generation.coordinate_policy: Reuse exact existing xyz and IDs; no shifts, scaling, clipping or elevation correction
